    Link cited references to works in a corpus

    Source: R/link-references.R
    sm_link_references.Rd

    Resolves cited DOIs and OpenAlex identifiers against the works in the corpus. Use this for corpora built from tables or saved before references were linked automatically. No network request is made.

    Usage

    sm_link_references(
  corpus,
  by = c("doi", "openalex_id"),
  verbose = TRUE,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    corpus

    An sm_corpus object.

    by

    Identifiers to match, in priority order: "doi" and "openalex_id" by default.

    verbose

    Report the numbers of linked and unresolved references.

    call

    Caller environment for error reporting.

    Value

    The corpus with references$cited_work_id filled where possible.

    Details

    Links to existing corpus works are preserved. Missing or dangling links are resolved by a normalised DOI in cited_doi or a Web of Science DOI field in cited_raw, including bracketed DOI lists. OpenAlex matching accepts a whole short work id or its URL in cited_raw. A match must identify exactly one work and must not point to the citing work itself. The first identifier type in by giving a unique, non-self match wins. A dangling link without a match is retained. The source identifiers and provenance are unchanged. Locked corpora must first be unlocked.

    Readers and fetchers that build references, sm_bind_corpora() and sm_dedupe() link automatically. sm_corpus(), sm_corpus_from_tables(), new_sm_corpus(), sm_materialise(), subsetting and sm_example_corpus() take the supplied links as given.

    See also

    Other corpus: as_sm_corpus(), is_sm_corpus(), sm_bind_corpora(), sm_build_corpus(), sm_concept_vocabularies(), sm_corpus(), sm_corpus_from_tables(), sm_dedupe(), sm_materialise(), sm_oa_statuses(), sm_save_corpus(), sm_validate(), validate_sm_corpus()

    Examples

    corpus <- readRDS(sm_example_files("example_realuse_corpus.rds"))
linked <- sm_link_references(corpus)
#> ℹ 226 of 2316 references point to corpus works (226 newly linked).
#> ℹ 0 ambiguous matches and 0 self-matches remain unresolved.
sum(linked$references$cited_work_id %in% linked$works$work_id)
#> [1] 226
